detail.longDescription: Pinning a plugin to a commit SHA pins nothing if you never check where git landed. Air Security's Plugin4Shell: name a branch after that SHA, make it the default, and git checkout <sha> resolves to the branch with just a warning. GitHub rejects such names; Bitbucket and self-hosted git don't. Claude Code and Codex are fixed, Copilot isn't. The check: test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SHA" https://www. air.security/blog-posts/plugin 4shell # Cybersecurity # AIAgents # Git
